project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, estates and neighbouring settlements do not inflate the place score. Settlement merit was assessed before applying the map threshold; standalone attractions were not transferred into the town score. Angus-wide full-audit follow-up 2026-09-01: Lunan Bay is published as a separate coastal attraction with its own practical information and does not raise the hamlet score.
